lines.en: I hover over scorched grass.
My wings fan sparks downward.
The rings I fly glow orange.
My hornet shell is burnt black.

lines.zh: 我的飞行路线一直很直
lines.en: My flight line stays straight.
A scorched smell follows my path.
The launcher stays at my tail.
I drop low and skim the treetops.
Fire scatters off my wings.

lines.zh: 我绕一圈，回到同一条线
lines.en: I loop and return to the same line.
My shadow smokes on the ground.

lines.zh: 我飞得不算快，路线很稳
lines.en: Not fast, but my line holds.
The air heats ahead of me.
I rise a little and level out.
My plating creaks.

lines.zh: 我朝着有动静的方向飞
lines.en: I fly toward the movement.
I hold mid-air, wings never still.
My shell stays hot.
Sparks drop into the grass and smoke rises.

lines.zh: 我在等一条直线的目标
lines.en: I wait for a target on my line.
My compound eyes are full of firelight.
I hum faintly.
The grass below has already charred.
I turn through a small angle.
My wing edges are curling.
The wind pushes my flames aside.
Wings beating — no need to land.
Waiting for the next run.
I hover at your height.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边冒烟
lines.en: My shadow smokes at your feet.
You didn't move. Good.

lines.zh: 我的尾部已经抬起来了
lines.en: My tail section has lifted.
I hover with my tail aimed at you.
I slide slowly sideways.
I can't hear your breathing.
The fire is too loud.

lines.zh: 我画了个圈，又回到原处
lines.en: I loop and return to the spot.

lines.zh: 这只是让你以为我要走
lines.en: That was only to make you think I'd leave.
I never went away.
I'm still on the line.
One moment more, then I fly over.
A crack in my shell spits fire.

lines.zh: 我拖着的火焰，把草都点着了。
lines.en: The flame I trail sets the grass alight.
A lot of sparks fall off.
My hum drops lower.
I get back on that line.
One wing won't quite work.
That didn't bring me down.
But the fire's weaker.
You hit a good spot.
One more and it's uncertain.
That thing won't stop fire.
You hold it up — I can burn it.
I don't live by eating.
Everything of mine has to be fire-touched.

lines.zh: 你放下来，我看看能不能点
lines.en: Set it down and I'll see if it lights.
Too wet. It won't catch.
I circle once. No interest.
Step back or my fire will splash you.
That's hardly any kind of bait.
Keep holding it and I'll burn it.

lines.zh: 你撞了我，翅膀偏了一下
lines.en: You hit me and a wing slips.
Sparks land on your sleeve.
I steady my altitude and realign.
That jolt makes my flames sputter.

lines.zh: 我退开两格，怕自己的火
lines.en: I back off two blocks from my own fire.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我的壳，很烫
lines.en: Your hand touches my shell. It's hot.
I roll over and get back on line.
The scorched smell is thickening.
That doesn't count as a fight.
Hit me again and I fire straight.

lines.zh: 这条线只有我一个在飞
lines.en: Only I fly this line.
Another one circles a mile off.
We each hold a stretch.
When we meet, we burn together.
This body needs no mate.
But I know the hum of my own kind.
You don't have that sound.
So you're still a target.
I'll keep flying my circuit.
You just stand right there.
I dip and snatch.
It caught fire in my grip.
I carry it up as I climb.
Too hot. I fling it off.
You dropped it. I burnt it to ash.
This won't burn. Interesting.
I hook it under my abdomen.
I can't carry much.
Useless things I drop.
You'd better not pick it back up.
You're on my line.
I raise my tail section.
Aligned. Straight line.
This shot needs no calculation.
As long as you stay there.
I'm coming in low.
Sparks first, then the shot.
Raise a hand; it won't stop heat.
I arc around to your flank.
Firing right now.

lines.zh: 我沿着你头顶的弧线飞
lines.en: I fly the arc above your head.
Each pass is a little lower.
My firelight stays on you.
Wherever you go, I adjust.
I've flown this line many times.
I could fly it with my eyes shut.
Your position is drifting left.
So I drift over with it.
Your hands still aren't down.
Then you can only guard one side.
The fire comes from the other.
This is the very moment.
I dive, tail section first.
Fire bursts across your armour.
My shell strikes your shoulder, hot.
You fall back, your cuff still burning.
I pull up and circle back.
That one only grazed.
Sparks scatter on the ground.
I'm back on the same line.
A scorch mark on your armour.
Next time it will be dead centre.
I appear inside a burst of flame.
First comes the smell of scorched grass.

lines.zh: 我从火里穿出来，壳还黑着
lines.en: I fly out of the fire, shell still black.

lines.zh: 翅膀一开始就是燃着的
lines.en: My wings were burning from the start.
I've chosen this open ground.

lines.zh: 这里有一条好飞的直线
lines.en: There's a good straight run here.
I circle once to record altitude.
Fire leaves a trace in the air.
I stop and glance at you.
Then I fly on ahead.
This line is mine now.
You'd best not stand on it.
Fire does nothing to me, but it's loud.
I hit the ground and sparks fly wide.
Water hits and my shell hisses.

lines.zh: 气浪把我卷着翻了几转
lines.en: The blast rolls me over and over.
An arrow through my wing leaks fire.

lines.zh: 这光让我的火一下灭了
lines.en: That light snuffs my fire at once.
The fire's weak. I can't climb.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的壳上，火全炸开
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and the fire bursts out.
No ground. No heading.
